The present contempt petition under Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act seeks following prayers:-
"a.
To hold the Respondents, guilty of committing Contempt of Order of the Judgement Dated 07.04.2025 passed by Sh. Arun Sukhija, Ld. Principal Judge,
Family Courts, West District, Tis Hazari Courts, New Delhi in H.M.A No. 850/2025 titled as "Samiksha Ahuja Vs Shivam Dhingra" and may further be pleased to punish the Respondent as provided under Section 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 for wilful disobedience of the Judgement dated 07.04.2025; b. Initiate contempt proceedings against the contemnors for wilful disobedience of Judgment dated 07.04.2025;
c. Direct the Contemnors to purge themselves of the Contempt by providing necessary NOC and Documents and Statements for the Quashing of the FIR no .
560/2021, P.S Kirti Nagar, U/Section 498A/406/34 IPC;
d . Pass such other or further order(s) as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the interest of Justice, Equity and fairplay."
